description_en: Queries the audit log configurations of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. The configurations include whether the audit log feature is enabled and the retention period of audit logs
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例审计日志是否开启、日志保存时间等配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-audit-log-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAuditLogConfig

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473779.html operation to query the region ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属地域的ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473779.html接口查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: instance_id

DbAudit.description_en:
Indicates whether the audit log feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled

You can call the [ModifyAuditLogConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473829.html） operation to enable or disable the audit log feature for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
DbAudit.description_zh:
是否开启审计日志，返回值：
true：开启。
false：关闭。

您可以调用[ModifyAuditLogConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473829.html）接口为实例开启或关闭审计日志

Retention.description_en: The retention period of audit logs. Unit: days
Retention.description_zh: 审计日志的保留时长，单位为天
